# copy-id

A "Copy prototype ID" button in the prototype detail pane's header. One click
puts the open prototype's id (its minted folder name, `proto-…`) on the
clipboard, so it can be pasted into a prompt or a `./singularity prototype`
command.

It is the prototype twin of `apps/pages/copy-id`'s "Copy block ID". The
feedback is the button's own check-mark flash — the button stays on screen
after the click, so no toast is needed.
